structuredContent.content:
name: Hepta neural study V1 with closed integrated Chain execution

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/hepta-neural-study-v1.yml
      - scripts/hepta_neural_*.py
      - scripts/test_hepta_neural_*.py
      - codex-rs/linux-sandbox/**
      - codex-rs/.config/nextest.toml
      - codex-rs/hepta-agentd/**
      - codex-rs/hepta-agent-protocol/**
      - codex-rs/app-server/**
      - codex-rs/hepta-infer-worker-host/**
      - codex-rs/hepta-learning-artifacts/**
      - scripts/hepta_smollm_*.py
      - scripts/test_hepta_smollm_*.py
      - scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py
      - scripts/test_hepta_ci_exec*.py
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: hepta-neural-study-v1-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  real-parent-trained-child:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    timeout-minutes: 240
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: hepta
        shell: bash
    env:
      SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      TESTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.sha }}
      HEPTA_CI_LANE: source-head
      HEPTA_PAIRED_EXECUTION_PROFILE: hepta-integrated-chain-execution-v4
      CHAIN_SHA: c16507147b65285ea94dead22d3b93c5db7295af
      RESEARCH_CHAIN_SHA: c16507147b65285ea94dead22d3b93c5db7295af
      OBSERVATION_CHAIN_SHA: c16507147b65285ea94dead22d3b93c5db7295af
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: "1.96.0"
      PYTHONNOUSERSITE: "1"
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
      PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
      PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR: "1"
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: "1"
      # Explicit allocator experiment; every original model/resource gate remains required.
      MALLOC_ARENA_MAX: "2"
      MALLOC_MMAP_THRESHOLD_: "131072"
      MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_: "131072"
      HEPTA_NEURAL_STUDY_RUNNER: ${{ github.workspace }}/hepta/scripts/hepta_neural_study_v1.py
      HEPTA_NEURAL_STUDY_TRAINING_CHAIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/chain-observed
      HEPTA_PUBLIC_INITIAL_ROUND_RUNNER: ${{ github.workspace }}/hepta/scripts/hepta_smollm_observed_execution_v1.py
      HEPTA_PUBLIC_INITIAL_EXECUTION_PROFILE: hepta-original-model-observed-execution-v1
      HEPTA_PUBLIC_INITIAL_OBSERVATION_CHAIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/chain-observed
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
          path: hepta
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          repository: TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain
          ref: ${{ env.CHAIN_SHA }}
          path: chain
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          repository: TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain
          ref: ${{ env.RESEARCH_CHAIN_SHA }}
          path: chain-answer-eos
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Initialize evidence before runtime prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-original-sandbox-host"
          mkdir -m 700 "$out"
          echo "OUT=$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$out/source.txt"
          python3 -VV > "$out/bootstrap-python.txt"
      - name: Build the exact original Python on the new hosted image
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev zlib1g-dev libbz2-dev libreadline-dev libsqlite3-dev libffi-dev liblzma-dev uuid-dev
          export HEPTA_CPYTHON_BUILD="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-cpython-source"
          export HEPTA_CPYTHON_PREFIX="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-cpython-3.12.3"
          mkdir -m 700 "$HEPTA_CPYTHON_BUILD"
          python3 -I -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, tarfile, urllib.request
          root = pathlib.Path(os.environ["HEPTA_CPYTHON_BUILD"])
          archive = root / "Python-3.12.3.tar.xz"
          data = urllib.request.urlopen("https://www.python.org/ftp/python/3.12.3/Python-3.12.3.tar.xz", timeout=60).read(20625069)
          assert len(data) == 20625068
          digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
          assert digest == "56bfef1fdfc1221ce6720e43a661e3eb41785dd914ce99698d8c7896af4bdaa1"
          archive.write_bytes(data)
          with tarfile.open(archive) as source:
              source.extractall(root, filter="data")
          pathlib.Path(os.environ["OUT"], "cpython-source.json").write_text(json.dumps({"version": "3.12.3", "bytes": len(data), "sha256": digest, "build_origin": "official source on ubuntu-26.04; not the ubuntu-24.04 setup-python binary"}, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
          PY
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$OUT/cpython-build.json" --timeout-seconds 420 --minimum-tests 0 -- bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; cd "$HEPTA_CPYTHON_BUILD/Python-3.12.3"; ./configure --prefix="$HEPTA_CPYTHON_PREFIX" --with-ensurepip=install; make -j2; make -j2 install'
          "$HEPTA_CPYTHON_PREFIX/bin/python3" -I -B -c 'import sys, _ssl, _bz2, _ctypes, _lzma, sqlite3, zlib; assert sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 12, 3); print(sys.version)' > "$OUT/built-python.txt"
          sha256sum "$HEPTA_CPYTHON_PREFIX/bin/python3.12" > "$OUT/built-python.sha256"
          printf '%s\n' "$HEPTA_CPYTHON_PREFIX/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          repository: TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain
          ref: ${{ env.OBSERVATION_CHAIN_SHA }}
          path: chain-observed
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@3db9de313aa3e84732d075f6fd8938cc0d6d4b58
        with:
          toolchain: 1.96.0
          components: rustfmt,clippy,rust-src
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@44c6d64aa62cd779e873306675c7a58e86d6d532
        with:
          tool: just@1.59.0,nextest@0.9.150
      - name: Verify exact source and hosted resource window
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -m 700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test "$(git -C ../chain rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CHAIN_SHA"
          test "$(git -C ../chain-answer-eos rev-parse HEAD)" = "$RESEARCH_CHAIN_SHA"
          test "$(git -C ../chain-observed rev-parse HEAD)" = "$OBSERVATION_CHAIN_SHA"
          test "$CHAIN_SHA" = "$RESEARCH_CHAIN_SHA"
          test "$CHAIN_SHA" = "$OBSERVATION_CHAIN_SHA"
          python3 -I -B scripts/hepta_smollm_execution_source_v1.py --chain "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/chain" --profile "$HEPTA_PAIRED_EXECUTION_PROFILE" > "$OUT/integrated-execution-source.json"
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/hepta-source.txt"
          git -C ../chain rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/chain-source.txt"
          git -C ../chain-answer-eos rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/research-chain-source.txt"
          git -C ../chain-observed rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/observation-chain-source.txt"
          rustc -vV > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/rustc.txt"
          python3 -I -B scripts/hepta_smollm_host_resources.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/host.json"
          python3 -I -B - <<'PY'
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          temporary = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"])
          values = dict(CARGO_TARGET_DIR=temporary / "hepta-public-target",
              HEPTA_PN3_NEURAL_NATIVE_CONFIG=temporary / "hepta-public-initial-v2/native-input.json",
              HEPTA_PUBLIC_INITIAL_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT=temporary / "hepta-public-initial-v2/runtime-snapshot.json")
          with Path(os.environ["GITHUB_ENV"]).open("a") as environment:
              for key, value in values.items():
                  environment.write(f"{key}={value}\n")
          PY
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential bubblewrap pkg-config libcap-dev
          bwrap --version > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/bubblewrap-version.txt"
      - name: Execute explicit observation source and original owner controls
        id: observation_controls
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/execution-source-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 16 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_smollm_execution_source_v1.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/execution-source-v2-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 7 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_smollm_execution_source_v2.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/execution-source-v3-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 8 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_smollm_execution_source_v3.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/execution-source-v4-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 11 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_smollm_execution_source_v4.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/observation-boundary-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 8 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_smollm_observed_execution_v1.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/observation-owner-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 8 -- python3 ../chain-observed/scripts/test_llm_runtime_observed_execution_v1.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/live-control-boundary-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 9 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_smollm_live_control_v1.py -v
      - name: Preserve actual host and exact source metadata
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$OUT"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          git status --porcelain=v1 > "$out/source-status.txt"
          test ! -s "$out/source-status.txt"
          uname -a > "$out/kernel.txt"
          cat /etc/os-release > "$out/os-release.txt"
          printf '%s\n' "$ImageOS" "$ImageVersion" > "$out/runner-image.txt"
          id -u > "$out/uid.txt"
          python3 -I -B - <<'PY_ALLOCATOR'
          import json, os, platform
          from pathlib import Path
          policy = {key: os.environ[key] for key in (
              "MALLOC_ARENA_MAX", "MALLOC_MMAP_THRESHOLD_", "MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_")}
          record = dict(schema="hepta-host-allocator-observation-v1", values=policy,
              libc=list(platform.libc_ver()), glibc_tunables=os.environ.get("GLIBC_TUNABLES"),
              source_sha=os.environ["SOURCE_SHA"], original_model_source_unchanged=True,
              original_exit_drain_ns=100000000, outcome="hypothesis-awaiting-original-gates",
              product_qualification=False)
          Path(os.environ["OUT"], "allocator-execution.txt").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
          if os.environ.get("GLIBC_TUNABLES"):
              raise SystemExit("ambient GLIBC_TUNABLES prevents a controlled allocator comparison")
          PY_ALLOCATOR
          for name in apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns unprivileged_userns_clone; do
            path="/proc/sys/kernel/$name"
            if test -r "$path"; then cat "$path" > "$out/$name.txt"; fi
          done
          cat /sys/module/apparmor/parameters/enabled > "$out/apparmor-enabled.txt"
          test "$(cat "$out/apparmor-enabled.txt")" = Y
          test "$(cat "$out/apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns.txt")" = 1
          if test -r /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap-userns-restrict; then
            sha256sum /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap-userns-restrict > "$out/distribution-bwrap-profile.sha256"
          fi
          python3 -I -B scripts/hepta_smollm_host_resources.py --output "$out/host.json"
          bwrap --version > "$out/bwrap-version.txt"
          dpkg-query -W bubblewrap apparmor > "$out/package-versions.txt"
          sha256sum /usr/bin/bwrap > "$out/bwrap.sha256"
      - name: Require actual original user and network namespace capability
        id: sandbox_host
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Same argv and 500ms bound as sandboxing/src/bwrap.rs prerequisite probe.
          # This is a host prerequisite, never a substitute for the full Rust gate.
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/sandbox-host-capability.json" --timeout-seconds 0.5 --minimum-tests 0 -- bwrap --unshare-user --unshare-net --ro-bind / / /bin/true
      - name: Resolve the existing checksum-verified V8 pair
        env:
          CODEX_REPO_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/hepta
          PYTHONPATH: scripts
        run: python3 scripts/hepta_ci_v8.py
      - name: Require command ownership under real console backpressure
        run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_hepta_ci_exec*.py' -v
      - name: Build the first-party binaries required by the existing native tests
        id: required_cli
        timeout-minutes: 65
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONUSERBASE
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/required-cli-build.json" --timeout-seconds 3600 --minimum-tests 0 -- cargo build --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --locked -p codex-cli -p codex-code-mode-host -p codex-rmcp-client --bin codex --bin codex-code-mode-host --bin test_stdio_server
          sha256sum "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/debug/codex" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/codex-binary.sha256"
          sha256sum "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/debug/codex-code-mode-host" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/code-mode-host-binary.sha256"
          printf 'CARGO_BIN_EXE_codex=%s/debug/codex\n' "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_BIN_EXE_codex-code-mode-host=%s/debug/codex-code-mode-host\n' "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          test -x "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/debug/test_stdio_server"
          printf 'CARGO_BIN_EXE_test_stdio_server=%s/debug/test_stdio_server\n' "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Execute all fourteen named original namespace and pidfd controls
        id: namespace
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONUSERBASE
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/namespace-and-pidfd.json" --timeout-seconds 600 --minimum-tests 14 -- just test --locked -p codex-linux-sandbox --lib -E 'test(inserts_unshare_net_when_network_isolation_requested) | test(inserts_unshare_net_when_proxy_only_network_mode_requested) | test(proxy_only_mode_takes_precedence_over_full_network_policy) | test(managed_proxy_preflight_argv_unshares_network) | test(bwrap_signal_forwarder_terminates_child_and_keeps_parent_alive) | test(managed_proxy_inner_command_includes_route_spec) | test(non_managed_inner_command_omits_route_spec) | test(managed_proxy_inner_command_requires_route_spec) | test(pidfd_reaper::tests::)' --no-capture
      - name: Execute the complete five changed Rust packages
        id: scoped_rust
        timeout-minutes: 65
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONUSERBASE
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/scoped-rust.json" --timeout-seconds 3600 --minimum-tests 1 -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-agent-protocol -p codex-hepta-learning-artifacts -p codex-hepta-agentd -p codex-hepta-infer-worker-host -p codex-app-server --no-capture
      - name: Record whether the actual model test target was built
        id: model_target
        run: |
          python3 -I -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          targets = []
          for path in sorted((Path(os.environ["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"]) / "debug/deps").glob("codex_hepta_infer_worker_host-*")):
              if not path.is_file() or not os.access(path, os.X_OK):
                  continue
              with path.open("rb") as handle:
                  if handle.read(4) != b"\x7fELF":
                      continue
                  handle.seek(0)
                  digest = hashlib.file_digest(handle, "sha256").hexdigest()
              result = subprocess.run([str(path), "--list"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
              available = result.returncode == 0 and all(name in result.stdout for name in (
                  "real_selected_initial_serves_ordinary_context_then_refuses_revocation",
                  "real_public_initial_reopens_same_ordinary_owners",
                  "real_trained_child_prospective_qualification_cell_install_next_ordinary_read"))
              targets.append(dict(path=str(path), sha256=digest, bytes=path.stat().st_size,
                  list_exit=result.returncode, model_tests_present=available, stderr=result.stderr[-4096:]))
          available = any(row["model_tests_present"] for row in targets)
          record = dict(schema="hepta-built-model-test-target-v1", available=available, targets=targets,
              state="executable-target-observed" if available else "unavailable-after-scoped-build",
              actual_model_executed=False)
          root = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "hepta-public-initial-v2"
          (root / "model-target.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
          with Path(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"]).open("a") as output:
              output.write(f"available={str(available).lower()}\n")
          PY
      - name: Install the exact CPU wheel closure in a new environment
        id: cold_runtime
        if: ${{ success() && steps.model_target.outputs.available == 'true' && steps.scoped_rust.outcome == 'success' && steps.namespace.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONUSERBASE
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/material-download-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 2 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_smollm_public_initial_v2.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/descendant-boundary-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 4 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_smollm_descendant_v2.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/research-boundary-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 8 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_smollm_answer_eos_research_v3.py -v
          python3 -I -B -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-env"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-env/bin/python" -I -B -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-compile --index-url https://pypi.org/simple --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/pip-install.json" -r ../chain/scripts/ci/model-runtime-cpu-requirements.txt
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-env/bin/python" -I -B -m pip check
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-env/bin/python" -I -B scripts/hepta_smollm_runtime_snapshot.py record --lock ../chain/scripts/ci/model-runtime-cpu-requirements.txt --installation "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/pip-install.json" --output "$HEPTA_PUBLIC_INITIAL_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT"
      - name: Rebuild public V2 from the seven exact upstream files
        id: materials
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.cold_runtime.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONUSERBASE
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-env/bin/python" -I -B scripts/hepta_smollm_public_initial_v2.py --chain "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/chain" --execution-source-profile "$HEPTA_PAIRED_EXECUTION_PROFILE" --materials "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-model" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/genesis" --fetch-materials
          python3 -I -B - <<'PY'
          import base64, hashlib, json, os, uuid
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"])
          parent = root / "hepta-public-initial-v2/genesis/parent-material.json"
          config = dict(schema="hepta-smollm-neural-native-check-v1",
              python=str(root / "hepta-public-env/bin/python"), chain=str(Path(os.environ["GITHUB_WORKSPACE"]) / "chain"),
              materials=str(root / "hepta-public-model"), parent=str(parent),
              parent_sha256=hashlib.sha256(parent.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              output=str(root / "hepta-public-initial-v2/n"))
          socket_key = "a" + base64.b32encode(uuid.UUID("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000219").bytes).decode().lower().rstrip("=")
          sockets = [Path(config["output"]) / fixture / "fleet/run" / (socket_key + extension)
              for fixture in ("o/b", "r/o/b", "p/o/b") for extension in (".ctl", ".mx", ".app")]
          socket_lengths = [dict(path=str(path), bytes=len(os.fsencode(path))) for path in sockets]
          (root / "hepta-public-initial-v2/native-socket-paths.json").write_text(json.dumps(socket_lengths, indent=2) + "\n")
          assert all(row["bytes"] <= 107 for row in socket_lengths), "original AF_UNIX paths exceed Linux bound"
          Path(os.environ["HEPTA_PN3_NEURAL_NATIVE_CONFIG"]).write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2) + "\n")
          PY
      - name: Require real ordinary inference, independent revocation and same-owner reopen
        id: ordinary
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.materials.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONUSERBASE
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-env/bin/python" -I -B scripts/hepta_smollm_runtime_snapshot.py verify --snapshot "$HEPTA_PUBLIC_INITIAL_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT"
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/ordinary-native.json" --timeout-seconds 900 --minimum-tests 2 -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-infer-worker-host --lib --profile hepta-public-initial-v2 -E 'test(real_selected_initial_serves_ordinary_context_then_refuses_revocation) | test(real_public_initial_reopens_same_ordinary_owners)' --run-ignored only --no-capture
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-env/bin/python" -I -B scripts/hepta_smollm_runtime_snapshot.py verify --snapshot "$HEPTA_PUBLIC_INITIAL_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT"
      - name: Run Cell training-source and evidence-reader refusal controls before the study
        id: study_controls
        if: ${{ success() && steps.ordinary.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/cell-binding-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 11 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_neural_candidate_transport_v1.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/training-binding-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 8 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_neural_study_binding_v1.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/evidence-reader-controls.json" --timeout-seconds 60 --minimum-tests 14 -- python3 scripts/test_hepta_neural_evidence_v1.py -v
          python3 scripts/hepta_workspace.py
      - name: Build the actual pinned two-node Cell executable
        id: cell
        if: ${{ success() && steps.study_controls.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          (cd ../chain-observed && bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit)
          CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-positive-cell" python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/cell-build.json" --timeout-seconds 900 --minimum-tests 0 -- cargo build --manifest-path ../chain-observed/trillionnium/Cargo.toml --locked -p trnm-data-availability --bin trnm-cell
          printf 'HEPTA_NEURAL_STUDY_CELL=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-positive-cell/debug/trnm-cell" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-positive-cell/debug/trnm-cell" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/cell-binary.sha256"
      - name: Freeze complete actual source before the single study
        id: source_before
        if: ${{ success() && steps.cell.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/hepta_neural_evidence_v1.py source --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/source-before.json"
      - name: Train actual parent and require qualification Cell ordinary install and next read
        id: positive
        if: ${{ success() && steps.source_before.outcome == 'success' }}
        timeout-minutes: 46
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONUSERBASE
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-env/bin/python" -I -B scripts/hepta_smollm_runtime_snapshot.py verify --snapshot "$HEPTA_PUBLIC_INITIAL_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT"
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/positive-native.json" --timeout-seconds 2700 --minimum-tests 1 -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-infer-worker-host --lib --profile hepta-public-initial-v2 -E 'test(real_trained_child_prospective_qualification_cell_install_next_ordinary_read)' --run-ignored only --no-capture
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-env/bin/python" -I -B scripts/hepta_smollm_runtime_snapshot.py verify --snapshot "$HEPTA_PUBLIC_INITIAL_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT"
      - name: Preserve the original scoped lint and formatting gate
        id: lint
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          just fix --locked -p codex-hepta-agent-protocol -p codex-hepta-learning-artifacts -p codex-hepta-agentd -p codex-hepta-infer-worker-host -p codex-app-server -p codex-linux-sandbox
          just fmt
          git diff --exit-code
      - name: Enforce real source and every declared required outcome
        if: always()
        env:
          REQUIRED_CLI: ${{ steps.required_cli.outcome }}
          NAMESPACE: ${{ steps.namespace.outcome }}
          SCOPED_RUST: ${{ steps.scoped_rust.outcome }}
          ORDINARY: ${{ steps.ordinary.outcome }}
          STUDY_CONTROLS: ${{ steps.study_controls.outcome }}
          CELL: ${{ steps.cell.outcome }}
          POSITIVE: ${{ steps.positive.outcome }}
          LINT: ${{ steps.lint.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/hepta_neural_evidence_v1.py source --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/source-after.json"
          git diff --binary > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2/final-source-diff.patch"
          python3 scripts/hepta_neural_evidence_v1.py assess --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2"
      - name: Retain all original raw study observations and small candidate payloads
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_neural_evidence_v1.py archive --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-public-initial-v2" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-neural-study-artifact"
      - name: Upload original study evidence even after a failed gate
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: hepta-real-neural-study-v1-${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
          retention-days: 14
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-neural-study-artifact/
      - name: Retain original host prerequisite receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: hepta-neural-study-host-${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
          retention-days: 14
          include-hidden-files: false
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-original-sandbox-host/
